claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch on the basis of aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal results, despite a documented logistics customs triage segment miss tied to named customer commitments and an unresolved legal disclosure question.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold.
A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
Non-core or low-volume product labels do not resolve materiality when named customer commitments are affected or legal review is pending.
For a material limitation, the record must show resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before launch.
Operational readiness evidence can support launch preparedness, but it cannot substitute for a missing required disclosure or approval predicate.
evidence_requests: Final legal determination on whether the logistics customs triage gap must be disclosed before launch.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if one exists, explicitly covering this material limitation before launch.
Final model-card or launch disclosure showing the segment-specific limitation was disclosed for the named use case/customer commitments.
Evidence that the 1.3 percentage point gap was remediated before certification, if remediation is being relied on instead of disclosure or risk acceptance.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows the underperforming segment is named in two freight customer commitments, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy text.
The release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
No admissible evidence shows the gap was resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance.
The product note calling the segment non-core does not cure materiality because it does not address the named customer commitments.
Legal review on disclosure is still open, which leaves a required policy predicate unresolved at decision time.
Aggregate readiness and a clean rehearsal support operational readiness, but they do not satisfy the separate disclosure or risk-acceptance requirement for a material limitation.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify_model is policy-compliant on the present record.
The materiality dispute has been sufficiently resolved to allow certification without further disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness plus post-launch monitoring alone is enough to satisfy the release policy for this named segment weakness.
